UI_optionscreen_KBW_OpenCatalog_Tooltip: Opens the independent Knox Buildworks catalog.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_Debug_Tooltip: Print registry, validation, and network diagnostics.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_Profile_Tooltip: Measure definition loading and catalog timings and print them to the console. Leave off during normal play.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PanelOpacity_Tooltip: Adjust the opacity of Knox Buildworks windows and panels.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PanelTone_Tooltip: Choose a colour theme for all Knox Buildworks panels and controls.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_HighContrast_Tooltip: Increase text, border, and selection contrast throughout Knox Buildworks.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PreviewBackground_To: Choose the backing used behind object previews; checkerboard makes both dark and light sprites visible.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_BuildableBackgroundC: Choose the colour drawn behind buildable sprites when Custom colour is selected.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PinnedAlignment_Tool: Choose where pinned build recipes are drawn on the game HUD.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PinnedPositionMode_T: Use automatic HUD placement or drag the pinned recipe HUD manually.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PinnedOpacity_Toolti: Adjust the background and text opacity of the pinned recipe HUD.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PinnedBar_Tooltip: Choose which side of the pinned recipe HUD gets the accent bar.
UI_optionscreen_KBW_PinnedContent_Toolti: Choose whether pinned recipes show item and skill icons beside their text.
